risks.quote: Ensure that you always check your work and results; AI tools can be inaccurate.
Be aware of potential biases in AI models and strive to ensure fairness and equity in AI outcomes.
You should be aware of AI's negative environmental impact, due to the large amount of energy consumed by AI systems.

responsibilities.quote: Ensure that you always check your work and results; AI tools can be inaccurate.
Ensure that you check any references or citations produced by these AI tools; correct referencing is your responsibility.
Ensure that you have completed the UWTSD LLR's Infoskils unit on Artificial Intelligence before using any AI tools as part of your studies and assessment
It is imperative that you consider the ethical and legal implications of the use of AI tools when handling sensitive data.
